verdict.rationale: AMD provides official ROCm SDK docs enabling development against PyTorch, TensorFlow, JAX, ONNX, vLLM, and Llama.cpp on the RX 9070 XT, which supports agentic/AI workload building. However, this is a hardware+driver stack rather than a dedicated developer SDK/API product, and there's no evidence of official REST/API SDKs, code samples repositories, or independent hands-on corroboration of SDK usability. Missing for 10: independent developer corroboration of ROCm SDK experience on this GPU, evidence of language-specific SDK packages/bindings beyond framework support, and any API reference/OpenAPI-style documentation (probe shows openapi endpoints 404).
